description: The standard http package of Scaly, a compiled language whose memory lives in regions the compiler infers: no garbage collector, no borrow checker. One scheduler per core over io_uring, a fiber per connection, and a region per request that is freed when the handler returns. HTTP/1.1 with a parser resumable at any byte and pipelined responses in one write, HTTP/2 of its own, TLS 1.3 through OpenSSL, HTTP/3 through ngtcp2; JSON serialized per request by the json package, gzip through libdeflate. Built by the released toolchain as one whole-program module, profile-guided: the documented production build.
